Welcome to the First Giveaway from Wilder Whees! This is the official launch of the #WenWheels Meme Contest! (Previously posted on Oct. 10, 2021)

  CONTEST RULES: 
To celebrate the birth of our Discord server, the arrival of Sunshine and and the upcoming Wilder Wheels launch, WE ARE LAUNCHING A 48 HOUR MEME CONTEST TITLED: #WenWheels!
Do you want to know when Wilder Wheels will launch? Share your #WenWheels Meme to find out.

Reward:
  The Gold Medal winner will not only win bragging rights in the Wilder World discord but will also walk away with 1 Wilder Wheel. (You heard that right).

   The Silver Medal Winner will win a whole bunch of hype as they’ll be airdropped and will walk away with a bag of 333 $WILD along with getting a reserved spot to be the first to purchase 1 Wilder Wheels when they drop.

 The Bronze Medal winner will earn community claps and a whole bunch of love and will walk away with a bag of 111 $WILD along with getting a reserved spot to be the first to purchase a 1 Wilder Wheels when they drop.

 BONUS PRIZE! Retweet the tweet below and tag three friends for a chance to win a bonus Wilder Wheel! The winner will be randomly selected from the retweets at the closing of the WenWheels campaign.

 Timeline:
 Since the Wilder Nation knows best, the top three winners will be chosen BY COMMUNITY VOTE! The contest begins now and ends at 11:11PM PT October 12th, 2021.

Details on prizes, timeline, and how to enter and vote are below. (Oct. 10, 2021 post cont.) 

 Here’s How to Enter:
1. Create a Meme that embodies the culture of all Wilders asking #WenWheels. The image must include the words “wen wheels?”

3. After you’ve tweeted your masterpiece, post your tweet link in the │giveaways channel, where the Wilder World community will vote on your Meme. The community votes with the flame and car emoji.

1. Each Wilder World Discord Member will have up to 2 votes per Meme. 1 Flame   & 1 Race Car     (see example entry below).

5. All votes must be cast by 11:11 PM PT on October 12th, 2021.
6. Voting capabilities will be turned off at 11:12 PM PT on October 12th, 2021.

Official counts will be conducted and winners will be announced on this Discord channel and Twitter at 12:12 AM PT October 13th, 2021.

Redemption:
Winners MUST message Sunshine on Discord with their wallet address within 24 hours to confirm their win. If winners fail to share this information in the given amount of time, the meme with the next highest number of votes will be awarded space on the winners podium.

To give time for all contest winners to confirm their win and submit wallet addresses, we will make the airdrop sometime on October 15th.

Greetings Wilders - @everyone far and wide! 

  Coming to shed light on the community regarding Wilder Wheels metadata on OpenSea. I will quickly highlight what occurred and how we have chosen to compensate those who were most impacted by the situation.

  Due to the complex nature of our project, some of the Wilder Wheels NFTs that were dropped in the Phase B sale had errors in the metadata.   This affected the properties and imagery of some  NFTs on OpenSea. A small number of community members reached out to our support team to alert us of their issues and in turn, helped us to find a solution to the original issue.   

  We have since corrected the errors and 98% of Wheels are showing up on OpenSea correctly. We still have about 2% of Wheels holders experiencing issues and we are actively nudging OpenSea to deploy server updates so that our on-chain updates are reflected.

 In order to honor The Wilders who actively supported our team in solving the issue, we will be compensating them 50 WILD each. We have indexed all of the issues that were corrected in the collection, and cross referenced those who reached out directly through support. That number totaled 99. The eligible Wilders will receive an airdrop from our team on November 24, 2021. 

  The total amount in payout to these Wilder Spirits is 4,950 WILD and equates to ~$18,560 (not including ETH Gas Fees), which will be paid out from the DAO account. We believe this to be the best consolation for our community as we want to honor those who actively participate and support the project.   We appreciate everyone for their patience and support. We are grateful for our community and want to do the right thing.  

  Thank you!

Team Wilder               (edited)

How to Sign Up for the Whitelist Raffle

Step 1: Go to the [Wilder World Metaverse Market (WWMM)] (http://market.wilderworld.com/).

Step 2: Click the “Enter Raffle” banner on the top of the page then click “Connect Wallet” and sign to register.

Step 3: Next, you will be prompted to connect your wallet. Click the “Connect Wallet” button to do so.

Step 4: Choose which wallet works best for you. We recommend MetaMask(https://metamask.io/) but any on the list will do!

(If  you haven’t signed up for a wallet): Sign up for MetaMask (https://metamask.io/).

Step 5: If it is your first wallet, be sure you have WILD & ETH in your wallet. (To learn how to buy WILD, watch this short video - https://youtu.be/J7V4U1pBBpQ). 

Once funds have been added, return back to the Wilder World Metaverse Market (https://market.wilderworld.com/#/).

Step 6: Once connected, you will then be prompted to verify your entry by signing a transaction from your wallet. If you choose MetaMask the MetaMask extension will pop up and request an account to verify. (Signing a transaction will NOT require ETH).

Step 7:  Once verified, you will be prompted a second time for a signature. When your wallet is verified, you will receive a notification that your registration for the raffle has been confirmed and asked to enter your email. 

Step 8: Check in the #Cribs channel in the Wilder World Discord Monday, November 29th to view the winners of the Whitelist Raffle. 

More Details:  We will reserve 99 wallet addresses total for the whitelist sale and winners will have 48 hours to mint. If any Cribs remain available after 48 hours, we will open the sale up to the public and Cribs will go on a first come, first serve basis. (edited)

Wilder Wheels Update - 1/2

Greetings Wilders,

I am personally writing to update @everyone on some important matters relating to the overall Wilder Wheels campaign and some oversights from our end on how we communicated the execution.

I feel it’s super important to provide context for this situation and assure you that we are formulating a plan to resolve the matter which has been presented around the Wheels rarity following the distribution of our Ambassador Wheels earlier today.

Context for Citizens of the Wilder Nation

Back in June 2021, we conceived a Wilder Wheels marketing strategy with the intention to amplify the campaign ahead of launching the Wheels community and public sale drops.

At the time, our project was only one month old, still bootstrapping and looking at innovative ways we could maximize our marketing reach, ensuring early success for the project and the broader community who had just supported us through our IDO.

In this light, we ring fenced 202 Wilder Wheels to engage 101 of our closest crypto allies and partners that had large social media and community followings that could assist us in super boosting our marketing reach for the Wheels campaign. All of which was addressed in an official Wilder Medium post here: https://wilderworld.medium.com/wilder-wheels-community-whitelist-now-open-2a4e229d4677

This group of participants were to be given one Wheel to ROCK (auction for themselves or charity) and one Wheel to STOCK (HODL to race in Wiami for pink slips) and it would all take place via a Rare Art Car Auction on the WWMM that would be held several hours ahead of the broader Wheels campaign drop which we highlighted in this ZINE: https://zine.wilderworld.com/wheels-community-drop/

A provision of receiving the Wheels and gaining access to the Rare Art Car Auction was a commitment by the Ambassador to participate in and follow our coordinated marketing strategy so we could gather as much momentum and saturate the Twitterverse with the 101 Wheels at exactly the same time to get Wilder Wheels trending and heavily promote the public sale.

As it turned out, creating and distributing this amount of individual customized Wheels proved to be a massive undertaking with numerous complications and hurdles we had to overcome along the way that we couldn't foresee.

We therefore decided that it was not in the project's best interests to execute the Rare Art Car Auction, in fact it would be counterproductive to what we were trying to achieve with overall objectives of the Wheels campaign, which had now evolved at quantum speed from where we were in June when we drew up the Rare Art Car Auction strategy. In true Wilder Spirit we still honored our commitment to provide the Ambassador's Wheels as it was the right thing to do.

In retrospect, it was a massive oversight on our end that we did not fully communicate this process to the community and address which cars were allocated for the 101 Wilder Ambassadors; we were so deep in execution that this important step was missed. We fully own this situation and we apologize upfront for any confusion or alarm it may have caused the community when the Wheels were minted overnight.

Wilder Wheels Update - 2/2

Addressing the Wheels Rarity

Now that you have the context, we’d like to address the main issue which was brought up today around Ambassador Wheels skewing the overall rarity of the collection. This was an oversight by me and was no means our intent. At the time of distribution we were under the impression that the rarity for every vehicle in the collection was documented in the initial wheels rarity ZINE found here: https://zine.wilderworld.com/wilder-wheels-rarity/

We want to reassure Wilder Citizens and Wheels owners that we are laser focussed on fixing any potential matter that may relate to any inconsistencies existing around the Wheels Rarity since the Ambassador Wheels have been minted.

We are working with our Ambassadors directly as this communication is being published. I can guarantee you that our highest priority is the integrity of our Wheels Rarity and the Wilder Nation. 

We will provide you with a further and more detailed update in 24-48hrs time once we have completed our investigations and understand the appropriate steps to make this situation right.

And finally, I know it has been an interesting 48 hours for our Wheels industry in general - myself and the whole team have deeply appreciated all the support shown from the community and how we have all banded together to solve these issues. 

From the bottom of our hearts, we say thank you, it’s always humbling to be reminded of how early we still all are and how we are riding this wild wave together, through the ups and the downs - we have each other's backs.

Sending much love and appreciation to the Wilder Nation. Further updates are coming soon as we continue to determine the best course of action. Please stay tuned.

With gratitude,

Frank Wilder

Wilder.Pets FAQ
Do we have to stake WILD and farm it in a liquidity pool for the snapshot to work, or only one of them to have been included in the silent snapshot for Pets?
You don't have to stake WILD, but if you are staking WILD in either of the staking pools (or both), you will still be eligible to get in on the Pre-sale mintlist. After the snapshot you will have to register for the pre-sale, so keep your eyes out for that.There will be action to take after the snapshot though

What if I have 2 wallets that I use and they both have a nft in them? Will I still be eligible for the Pets Mintlist?
You could register one of the wallets, or move the nfts into one wallet. Either works.

Do we have to do ALL things to get on the Pets Mintlist?
As long as your wallet falls under at least one of the categories listed in the announcement, you will be ELIGIBLE to register for the Pre-Sale Mintlist.

What does Pre-Sale Mintlist mean?
It is identical to a Whitelist Pre-Sale, we have decided to call them Mintlist as opposed to Whitelist.

How many Pets mints will be available for the pre-sale?
At this time that is tbd, but remember that we will only allow one wallet per person to mint.

Regarding people who had failed craft transactions, will they be getting a different compensation other than a pets presale spot?
We will be working to give them more compensation beyond the Pets Pre-sale mintlist but wanted to stay true to our original promise first. More information will be provided.

Am I guaranteed a Pets pre-sale spot if I make the snapshot?
After the snapshot, eligible community members will be required to manually register for the pre-sale mintlist spot. 

Will gas wars be possible during the pre-sale?
A gas war is possible, though very unlikely. There could potentially be a gas war if many of the minters attempted to mint at the same time. Details will be shared once we have outlined them.

Does it have to be in Metamask or does holding in exchange also count?
It had to be in a private wallet, Metamask would be an example of a private wallet.

What is the Mint price?
Mint price hasn’t been announced yet, or any other details regarding the Pets collection. Once the team has finished deciding the details of the drop, it will be announced.

What is a silent snapshot?
Silent snapshots are when a snapshot is taken at a non-announced time. A snapshot will capture the memory of all the wallets that hold one of the required categories in their private wallet on that day.

If I share a wallet with one or more friends will they be able to sign up for the pre-sale mintlist?
Yes, as long as that is the only wallet they sign up with. Remember only one wallet per person is allowed. 

In the metaverse, would my pet have any other utility?
Quantum: “We are definitely going to have more utility for your Pets. What I will share is you will be able to experience the metaverse through your pet or have your pet be a companion, so you could become your pet and all the utility that pet holds. You will be able to experience the metaverse with that additional utility as your pet and that could provide you several benefits when roaming the metaverse as your pet, but we will have a detailed utility announcement for pets we're putting the finishing touches on.” (edited)

How can I buy $WILD without paying tons of gas on Uniswap?
To avoid gas fees the most common way to purchase $WILD is on Kucoin, where you can use your bank/credit card to buy USDT and then SPOT buy $WILD/USDT. $WILD can then be sent to your private wallet for a fee of 5 WILD (subject to change) per withdrawal. Please ensure that you select the ERC20 network when withdrawing $WILD from Kucoin. Using the incorrect network will result in loss of your $WILD. Before you attempt that method, please do a google search to make sure that Kucoin allows your location. If you find out that this applies to your location, you’ll have to purchase usdt on a different exchange and move it to Kucoin wallet. Then purchase the wild, and proceed to move it to your non custodial wallet to be included in snapshots. 

Recent Team AMA FAQ
Can you share some light on some of the thinking behind releasing a roadmap without dates?
Quantum: “Yeah absolutely. I mean obviously with our last road map we had specific dates and we don't want to get in the same situation we were in before. I feel like at the end of the day, we're looking at what we're up to and we want to execute flawlessly on all these upcoming drops, and we just want to make sure that everything is done to the standard that you guys expect without any mistakes, and without any issues moving forward, To us, the dates aren't as important as the cadence of what we're doing in this roadmap, we actually pushed a lot of things off this latest road map. We really wanted to focus on fixing all these previous issues and and hit the ground running with a brand new foundation. (edited)
Wednesday, February 23, 2022 at 9:57 PM

What is the status of metadata issues with crafts wheels and kicks, and can you share a little bit about this process?
Quantum: “I think there's two sides to all the metadata issues that happened. We've improved our processes significantly from those early drops from these upcoming drops so we don't anticipate making the same mistakes again, and I feel like we learned a lot from them and we shouldn't see those issues in the future. The biggest challenge of these data issues is that it utilizes the resources of our blockchain dev team, which is probably one of the most taxed teams within the entire organization. Blockchain engineers are some of the hardest techs to come by right now, and that team is just working on a significant number of projects constantly. There's huge things that are important to this platform as a whole in the long term, like doing layer two integrations all the way to fixing problems like this metadata issue that requires some lift and resources on the blockchain team, so right now our biggest focus and priority is getting our smart contract system rewritten. So, in Opensea all the Wilder collections of the future will have their own collection page and their own smart contract.”

What's your best guess on when I'll be able to walk down the streets of Little Meow?
Quantum: “We are diving deep in this and you know we're starting to have an idea, but I can't really release any date details definitively at the moment. This year we're going to be opening up ring-fence-type experiences, and after that have a fully open board people can roam.”

As you guys think about prioritizing road map items, do you guys have any North Stars that guide roadmap prioritization decisions?
Quantum: “The real prioritization had been to really push as hard as we could, and see how far we could take this and how fast we could scale, but this road map was actually set with the prioritization of slowing down all the mistakes that came from that push, and and really preparing us for that next phase of scale.”

What about industry staking? Do we have updates on that?
Quantum: “That's a product team question, but I know we're committed to industry staking. This is another discussion around blockchain developers that build the smart contracts and underlying systems that are involved in any of the blockchain work we do. It is our biggest bottleneck across our entire team, but we have multiple interviews scheduled with more blockchain developers. We're looking at doubling the size of that team in the coming months. Staking is on the horizon, and the team's product schedule is getting this new contract smart contract system up and running. That's going to allow us to be on multiple contracts on Opensea, new collections, and it's going to fix some other issues on the back end. Industry staking is important to us. We haven't forgotten about it, it's in cues so to speak and I'll get more updates from the product team as we get further along with this roadmap.

@everyone 
⚠New NFT discord scam going around, this time using QR codes.⚠
 
Pretty terrible scam, but this is how it works:

So just like any other scam they hit you up looking for a collaboration, or a job offer or something like that, 
then you're asked to verify yourself. 

⚠Keep in mind this is a FAKE verified Wick bot.⚠ 

It will ask you to scan a QR code to verify yourself

When you go on the discord login page, it has a "Log in with QR Code" option. 
In this case, scammers are using chrome drivers to open the login page, get the QR code image, 
then send it to the discord bot, asking people to verify themselves.

As soon as anyone scans the QR code, it logs the scammer in and instantly grabs the victim's discord token, which provides access to the account and bypasses 2FA.

‼ If your discord token is compromised, 
all you have to do is reset your password and it will reset your token.‼

https://twitter.com/SerpentAU/status/1510872152085393411?s=20&t=L2kyktiAX7j6mIuvEjaJxQ

Greetings Wheels holders!

Shared below is a proposal for a vote to finalize the Wilder Wheels Genesis collection rarity. If you are wheels holder we encourage you to participate!

When Wheels first launched there wasn’t an industry standard established for calculating collection rarity. While certain tools and calculation methods were emerging, there wasn’t clear direction on their future and what would eventually be widely adopted. For this reason, we created G classes; they served as a way of categorizing Wheels based on IRL $ value, but not as an official rarity sheet like what we are currently creating.

While there are some outliers, the industry has largely conformed to calculation methods like those on third party sites like Rarity Tools and Rarity Sniper. Integrating Wheels into these sites was a primary objective as we developed the next iteration of Wheels rarity.

There have been a number of other situations that we’ve had to deal with along the road. A few of which are outlined below:

- Directly implementing G class into the rarity calculation would require manual adjustments which would sacrifice our ability to introduce third party rarity services to the collection, and leave opportunities on the table for collection exposure to the masses (Getting Wheels on the front pages of these sites could potentially bring in new Wilders to our community).

- The community voted to burn 3,705 Wheels, resulting in the desired supply of vehicles within G classes being unfavorably altered away from what they should have been, as well as consequences that we are continuing to maneuver around as we finalize Wheels rarity (for example, values and weights attributed to G classes and car names have changed because supply has changed).

- The G class rankings can never be perfect, as they are based on IRL value instead of actual NFT rarity.

After listening closely to community members voicing their feedback for our updated Wheels rarity, we’ve decided to pass the fate of this mission into the hands of Wilder citizens worldwide.

In taking community feedback into consideration, we’ve created a new proposal to revise the finalized Wheels rarity which will be outlined below. Our primary goals remain to optimize the Wheels collection for prosperous long-term growth as a Wilder NFT industry, modernize the collection by bringing it up to speed with current industry rarity standards, and to appease current Wheels holders while also considering the experience we want to provide to new Wilders joining the community.

The proposal is as follows: 

If we want to find a middle ground to keep collection integrity as initially stated and appease G classes, while also providing room for the Wheels to evolve and reach new heights, we have to apply a 5x multiplier (recently updated to a 2x multiplier) to the car name attribute. 

While there will still be some discrepancies among some of the G classes, this is the best way to maintain the original thesis of Wheels rarity while allowing the collection to be properly indexed and work with third parties that have become industry standards.

All Wilders may voice their opinions through a community vote on Thursday, July 14th with four options to choose from:

Option 1 - Approve the newly proposed rarity and implement 5x multiplier to car name
Option 2 - Keep 2x multiplier to car name
Option 3 - Use the G classes by creating custom rarity sheet that rigidly segments rarity purely by G class, then by car name within those G classes, and finally by traits

Option 1:
- Closely aligns with G class sequence 
- Modernizes the Wheels collection to current industry rarity standards
- Enables us to integrate Wheels rarity into third parties (Rarity Tools, for example)
- Provides the best (and least confusing) user experience for new Wilders viewing the Wheels collection for the first time
- Is consistent with how rarity could be calculated in future collections
- Enables non-primary traits to have somewhat of an impact on rarity

Option 2:
- Fully outlined in this Zine: https://zine.wilderworld.com/wilder-wheels-rarity/ 
- Achieves the same goals as option 1, but with a looser car name multiplier and more room for non-primary traits to impact rarity rankings

Option 3:
- We create a rarity document in similar fashion to how G classes were originally created; fully custom-made in a largely manual process
- The option to most highly align rarity with G class
- Sacrifices the ability to integrate with third parties, and in turn, removes the growth opportunities for Wheels that those integrations would provide
- Strays from current industry standards
- Not in line with how rarity will be calculated in future collections
- Highly confusing to new Wilders seeing the collection for the first time

Team Wilder recognizes that there is no one perfect solution to Wheels rarity where every holder is 100% happy, and we’ve done our best to minimize the number of holders who could potentially be negatively impacted.

To us, option 1 is the proper middle ground between the original thesis behind Wheels rarity with G classes and the evolution of the Wheels collection through its modernization up to current industry standards. 

We will be hosting the vote in Discord from Thursday July 14th at 12pm PST to Saturday July 16th at 12pm PST. Votes will be tallied and announced on Monday July 18th.

In this moment, the Wheels industry is in your hands Wilders.

Sending blessings to all,

Team Wilder

ALPHA RACING GAME UPDATE   

Greetings Wilders!   

  It’s time to make a pit stop to update you all on the latest news regarding the Wilder Wheels Alpha Racing experience. For those new here, we’ll share some context to get you up to speed on the matter at hand.   

  CONTEXT 
  Last December, n3o and Frank shared a short racing snippet with the community on Twitter/Discord. While it was one of the first opportunities to see the experience in motion, the team had concerns related to the quality and decided to delay the release with a new plan.

 The plan prepared a select group of Allies for testing out the Wheels Alpha Racing game to explore game mechanics like unique asset experience, drivability, handling, and shifting.

 Shortly after the process began, the team encountered a critical bug in the Unreal Engine 5 (UE5) multiplayer system that limited our ability to shift gears in the game. This became a major blocker for the Alpha testing experience   

 We then redirected our team's efforts to developing other parts of the in-world experience. 

 Luckily, the Wilder community came together and upvoted to fix this bug by swarming the Unreal Engine forums.

  Bug link here:  https://www.google.com/url?q=https://issues.unrealengine.com/issue/UE-144539&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1665799698377472&usg=AOvVaw0CxiRE1hfCnkBUVIlBaKxM

  NEW UPDATES  
  This month, our team received a release candidate notice from UE5 stating that the bug that limited shifting gears in the racing game has indeed been fixed   The fix will be available in preview mode for testing, however is not yet deployed in their stable (production ready) build. 

  What that means is that the new version of UE5 (Version 5.1.0) is still in preview mode and before we can fully implement changes to our Alpha Racing Experience, it needs to be deployed to their production version 

  Once UE5 ships the updated version into their stable build, our team will migrate the changes within ~60 days to the Wilder World production release, and then provide a Wheels Alpha Racing Roadmap for our community to be made aware of the process and timeline. While we don’t have a hard date for when that will be, our team will share an update when the new version gets shipped into production mode.

  Updates regarding Wheels Staking will be released next week.

  Lastly, we want to give a big shout out to everyone in the community who helped upvote the UE5 bug, which brought it to the top of their priority list! Without your involvement, it may not have been addressed and so for that, the Wilders Salute you!  

Blessings @everyone 
Team Wilder

Wilders:

I wanted to take a moment to give a quick update on Industry NFT staking. One of the primary reasons for the delay has been regulatory uncertainty from the SEC related to tying financial rewards to NFT assets. There is the argument that this can make NFTs securities, which would be detrimental to the project. In some cases certain projects have also been removed from OpenSea due to NFT staking rewards mechanisms.

An important part of being successful in Web3 is understanding the legal implications of key decisions in a rapidly emerging and uncertain landscape. This is not just for Wilder World, but the entire crypto industry. Those able to work within the bounds of the opaque regulation of crypto assets will have a much higher probability of success than those that don’t. 

We have engaged Reed Smith, arguably one of the top crypto-focused law firms in the world to help us with this matter. We believe we’ve found a way to ensure legal compliance with our NFT staking program by more deeply integrating staking into the mechanics of the metaverse and land resource economy (i.e., directly into the game). This is being designed in a way that connects all industries together with a single staking model that ties directly into different game mechanics, as well as the WILD token, using Zero's zXP Protocol. zXP has been improving rapidly. The open-source code can be viewed here: https://github.com/zer0-os/zXP.

In the end, it is my opinion that we will have something significantly better than was initially proposed as part of Metropolis v1, but for now, the timeline remains uncertain. The good news is that most of the technical challenges have been solved, and we are in the process of getting further legal confirmation that our proposed approach will work.

We will provide a further update with more clarity by the end of this year (2022). (edited)

CRAFTS RARITY & UPCOMING VOTE    

Greetings Wilders! 

We're excited to announce that we have made great progress in getting Crafts Rarity prepared. We are almost ready to flip the switch on the Crafts collection by implementing a standard rarity and it's going to require some community input to make sure alignment between rarity >< community are met. 

 Weighting Proposal
The rarity that will ultimately be implemented is up for community vote. On Nov 7th at 6 AM PDT we will open up a vote for 24 hours to allow for the community to vote on the best rarity system. We proposed 3 options, with a control of no weighting to show how each weight would impact the rarity. 

  Voting Options  
10x weighting for Model Type
25x weighting for Model Type
100x weighting for Model Type

With the help of our valued  @Allies community member, @sma11, we prepared a document that illustrates four systems. 

With the graph link below, you will be able to see three voting options (remember that no weight is just for a control, it will not be a voting option) that showcases the different options to choose from. The difference between each lies in how the Model Type is weighted. Starting with no weight implemented (as a control, not a vote), the multiplier increases across the following choices to 10x, 25x, and then 100x.

 See the Crafts Rarity Illustration at the Link Below (produced by @sma11 :
https://bit.ly/craftsrarity

(Graphs work best on desktop FYI )

Interactive models: If you click on the Model type in the graph legend you can turn on/off different Model types for more clarity.

Note: No weight will NOT favor Model Type in the rarity calculation over any other traits and provide a level playing field for all traits to impact rarity. This is why it’s not an option. 100x will provide a very rigid structure where the rarity rankings follow a Z-W-O-E-M order with very few discrepancies. 

 About the Vote 
The vote will take place in the  ⁠unknown channel between Nov 7 at 6 AM PT and Nov 8 at 6 AM PT. Once final votes are tallied, the Crafts rarity Zine will then be updated with rarity confirmed by community vote. The Zine will also be updated with appropriate Crafts Rarity graphs, a rarity spreadsheet, and an updated Crafts rarity bot will launch as well.

Thank you for your support in working through this process and for ensuring that Crafts Holders place their vote to collectively impact the Crafts Industry in the most positive and productive way possible.

WAPES DETAILS & MINTLIST   

Greetings Wilders  

Thank you for being patient with the Wilder Team on the Wapes drop details.   Recent changes in the industry as it relates to the Royalties Contract Requirements on OpenSea have effected the timeline of the Wapes drop and so we wanted to fill you in on the details as we know it. Given these changes, the Wapes Drop will be pushed into December.   We are currently ironing out tech specs to ensure our contracts are updated properly to meet these new standards and plan on giving a drop date when our contract updates are in a more complete state.

   The Details of Why?   
Early last week, OpenSea announced a Royalties Enforcement tool for their platform that directly effected the contract we prepared for the Wapes Drop. We’ve linked the full OS blog below for reference. Since royalties are a significant aspect of our business model and provide value to our DAO system, we want to be certain that we are implementing the appropriate updates according to the requirements.

The OS blog post shared that “New collections launched on OpenSea on or after 12 pm ET on November 8, must have on-chain enforcement methods implemented in order to set creator fees on OpenSea.” The Wapes contract was about 95% complete when this announcement went live. Last week, was spent auditing the Wapes contract and subsequent collections planned to assess the changes and scope of work required to meet these new standards.

  Note: While the OS requirements do not directly affect previous collections (yet), OS is engaging in open dialogue with the communities on their platform to assess how they would like to approach previous collections. We're currently wrapping our heads around our needs and how we aim to approach the conversation. Updates for previous collections could go into effect as soon as Dec.  8th, though it is not certain what will happen at that time.

  Link to the OpenSea Blog Post about Creator Royalties: https://opensea.io/blog/announcements/on-creator-fees/

  Other Details:  
While we originally planned to go out with details last week about the Wapes Collection, including mintlist, mint date and collection deets, we held off because we wanted more certainty about the impact these changes would have on Wapes and subsequent drops planned for the Wilder Nation before providing a bigger update.

  Snapshot & Mintlist Details:  
For those who missed it, the Wapes snapshot was taken last Wed, November 9th at 11.59pm PT. Wolf Holders were prioritized for this collection and we’ve allocated a total number of 2,750 mintlist spots to current Wolf Holders. The remaining total will be allocated to the DAO, the Marketing Wallet for community and growth activations, as well as partner relationships.

Greetings Wilder Nation!  

  We wanted to share a statement on the unfolding events within the industry, as it has been a rough month for crypto and the market. Our hearts and minds go out to those impacted by the recent events that took place at FTX. While there is grief, frustration and pain involved in moments like this, there is also an opportunity for us to get back to the essentials and focus on the most important thing: Building the metaverse. 

  To clear any concerns, Wilder World has no direct exposure to FTX, FTT tokens or Alameda. However, the blast radius extends further than first degree, and the proximity of being in this ecosystem is enough for us to lean towards being financially conservative to successfully navigate this period of industry and global risk, and slingshot out of this bear cycle. In thinking through this time, Wilder World has made the decision to decrease expenditures across the company. While this is a multi-faceted effort, one facet is reducing the number of team members.

 To those who are leaving, we value and appreciate the contributions each individual has made to help build Wilder World up to what it is and we honor you for the lasting impact you will forever have on our project. We will continue to drive this project forward and be as transparent as possible through the process.

  For all of you who were not able to attend the PSA with Frank & n3o today, here is a link to the recording. We appreciate the Wilder Nation and look forward to putting our heads down and working through this challenging moment in the industry.

Greetings Wilders  

  Important Update: The Wapes drop has been postponed to Wednesday, December 21st.  

  Sixteen months of work have gone into bringing this collection to life with six months dedicated to perfecting the production pipeline alone; the team has worked tirelessly to bring this collection to life. With that said, we have an important update to give you insights into why the Wapes Drop has been pushed back by one week. 

Nitty Gritty Details on Wapes Delay 
  After implementing OpenSea's new on-chain royalty changes to the Wapes contract, our Dev team discovered a bug during final inspection that was integrated deep into the sale contract that only allowed for one Wape to be minted per transaction. (Not ideal) To ensure everyone who has been allocated multiple Wapes for minting does not have to transact more than once and encounter multiple gas fees, our dev team needs to take additional time to fix this bug in the contract and to go through another round of testing the mint process. While this is unfortunate, we are mitigating the circumstance with our best efforts. 

Side Note: The demo release date has not been impacted by this and will still be released before the end of this year!

  New Drop Schedule
  Private Sale Opens: Wednesday, December 21, 2022 at 3:00 PM
  Private Sale Closes: upon collection sellout or on Thursday, December 22, 2022 at 3:00 PM

  If the collection does not sellout in the private sale, Wapes will go to a Public Sale.

  Public Sale Opens: Thursday, December 22, 2022 at 3:00 PM
  Public Sale Closes: upon collection sellout or on Friday, December 23, 2022 at 3:00 PM

 Note: There will be a cap of 9 Wapes total per wallet for the Public Sale (including any Wapes minted in the Private Sale)

Happy Mint Day Wilders! 

  With the Wapes Drop happening today we wanted to remind you of the Wapes Drop Schedule and provide step-by-step minting instructions! 

  Wapes Drop Schedule

  Private Sale Opens: Wednesday, December 21, 2022 at 3:00 PM
  Private Sale Closes: upon collection sellout or on Thursday, December 22, 2022 at 3:00 PM

  If the collection does not sellout in the private sale, Wapes will go to a Public Sale. 

  Public Sale Opens: Thursday, December 22, 2022 at 3:00 PM
  Public Sale Closes: upon collection sellout or on Friday, December 23, 2022 at 3:00 PM


   Step-by-Step Guide: How to Mint your Wapes   

  STEP 1
Go to the Wilder World Metaverse Market: https://app.wilderworld.com/market

At the top of the page there will be a banner that says ”Wapes are entering the portal”.  On the far right of the banner, click “Mint Now”. 

Please make sure you're on desktop when minting your WAPES.

 STEP 2
Once you've clicked "Mint Now" connect your wallet. Once you connect wallet, you will see a window with the number of WAPES you’re allowed to mint. Click the “MINT YOUR WAPES” button to start the minting process. 

Make sure you are signed in with the wallet that held your Wilder World assets during the snapshot we took on November 9th 2022.

 STEP 3
A pop up screen will appear that requires you to enter the number of WAPES you would like to mint in this transaction.  Enter the number of Wapes you would like to mint, mark that you agree to the auction terms and conditions, and then click “CONTINUE”.

Each WAPE costs 0.07 ETH.
Private Mint: Can mint all allocated to you after the snapshot.
Public Mint: No more than 9 can be minted.

 STEP 4
In your MetaMask wallet you will be prompted to confirm the transaction. Click “Confirm”.

If you are using a Ledger to mint, you will also be prompted to sign the transaction on your Ledger device.

 STEP 5
Once the MetaMask transaction is confirmed, a window will pop up to say “Minting your Wapes….”. This is to confirm that the transaction is being processed. This process may take some time if the network is busy. You may close this window and your Wapes will continue minting.

 STEP 6
When minting is completed, WAPES will be in your profile. Congratulations!


   Using Your Ledger to Mint
For more information on how to mint with your Ledger and ensure that you have the correct minting settings, check out the Wilder Wiki Ledger section here: 
https://wiki.wilderworld.com/wilder-world-resources/wilder-world-resources/ledger


   Not Sure if You're on the Mintlist?
Search for your wallet address on our official final mintlist: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/18GD09LHkq24a1afKi-tXh2VcVvK3i9_tBvuMRxNdWLc/edit#gid=0


  Gas Fees 
Within the Wapes minting period, there should be several gas fee lull periods that are optimal for minting.  As with all NFT mints, timing is key!

Please read the following article to learn some tips on how to minimize gas costs during the mint: https://ethereumprice.org/gas/

Blessings @everyone

Highlighting the major call-out in our last communication, Industry NFT staking had been delayed due to regulatory uncertainty from the SEC related to tying financial staking to NFT assets.

- The contracts have been written and need to be tested. 
- We will launch NFT Staking around the time we launch land to ensure legal compliance (we have a unique design we have been working on). 
- We are working with Reed Smith, one of the foremost legal experts in blockchain and crypto regulation, to help us execute. 

More updates to come in 2023.

Dear Wilders, 

 Following on our comms from Monday (3/13), we wanted to inform you of relevant news related to improvements in our tokenomics.  

  Headline upfront: We are reaching out to Coinmarketcap (CMC) and Coingecko (CG) to correct inaccurate Circulating Supply numbers on our token pages. 
As previously noted, both CMC and CG calculate Circulating Supply numbers using their own methods. Related to our original tokenomics established when the WILD token was launched - and as many of you have highlighted in the past - our Circulating Supply numbers have not been accurately reflected. 

While we do not have control over what CMC and CG determine the Circulating Supply to be, we believe the recent on-chain movements will support our case in having the Circulating Supply numbers on both platforms more accurately reflect how many tokens have actually vested and are circulating on the market as of this date. What this means is that changes to our Circulating Supply could be happening soon; and while this will change the Market Cap of the project, it will not change the actual market cap (i.e. the Fully Diluted Market Cap or FDMC) or token price of WILD. 

That said, we are pleased for this change to be reflected, as the implication of the changes in Circulating Supply is that our global ranking on both CMC and CG will be elevated, thereby increasing visibility of the project and benefiting Wilders far and wide. 

  As always, thank you for your support of this project. If Wilders have any questions, please let us know; we will make sure to canvass FAQs and respond with a public address. To be sure, this is one of many things happening behind the scenes to supercharge the WILD token. We could not be more happy that it is happening now.

Blessings @everyone 
Team Wilder

Happy Claim Day Wilders    

   THE GENS TRINITY KEEPER CLAIM GOES LIVE IN ONE HOUR!!  

  We wanted to provide you all with instructions on how to mint your GENs before the claim goes live!!



  How to Claim Your GEN(s)

  STEP 1 
Go to the Wilder World Metaverse Market to claim your GEN(s): https://app.wilderworld.com/market

At the top of the website there is a banner that says ”GENs are Materializing…” with a countdown to the claim going live. 

On the far right of the banner it says “Learn More”.  When the claim goes live “Learn More” will change to “Mint Now”.


  STEP 2 
Once you've clicked "Mint Now” you’ll be prompted to connect your wallet. After connecting your wallet, a window will pop up to show you how many GENs you can claim. 

  Make sure you are signed in with the wallet that held your Wilder World Trinity/Trinities during the snapshot we took on March 1st, 2023 at 11.59 PST. You will be eligible to claim one GEN per Trinity captured in the snapshot.

  Link to Trinity Keeper Mintlist: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1A66Yee_sVP-f3w_rpa4b2Xzjl98aUxQI7SEnyRo6m84/edit#gid=0 


  STEP 3 
A pop up screen will appear that prompts you to enter the number of GENs you would like to claim in this transaction. 

 You can claim your allocation in one transaction or spread out your allocation in multiple transactions, but bear in mind that you will need to pay ETH gas fees for each transaction you make.


  STEP 4 
Once you enter the number of GENs you wish to claim, you will be prompted to confirm the transaction. Click “Confirm”.  

If you are using a Ledger to mint, you will also be prompted to sign the transaction on your Ledger device. 


  STEP 5 
Once the MetaMask transaction is confirmed, a window will pop up to say “Minting your GENs”. This is to confirm that the transaction is being processed. This process may take some time if the network is busy. You may close the window and your GENs will continue minting. 


  STEP 6 
When the minting process is complete the GENs will show in your profile. Congratulations! 


 For more information on how to mint with your Ledger and ensure that you have the correct minting settings, check out the Wilder Wiki Ledger section here: https://wiki.wilderworld.com/wilder-world-resources/wilder-world-resources/ledger 

  If you face any issues with your claim then please open a ⁠No Access ticket!!
